ISRO ICRB Assistant, UDC, JPA, Stenographer Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) has released the answer key for the post of Assistants, Upper Division Clerk (UDC), Junior Personal Assistant (JPA), and Stenographer. This recruitment was released for 242 posts. Online applying process for ISRO Assistant, UDC, JPA, Stenographer Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 27 July 2026 to 20 August 2026. The CBT examination is going to conducted on 21 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their ISRO Assistant, UDC, JPA, Stenographer Answer Key 2026 from the link given below

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 27 July 2026
  • Last Date : 20 August 2026 (Extended)
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 21 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 25 September 2026

Application Fee

  • All Category Candidate : Rs. 500/-
  • After Appear CBT Exam Refund : Rs. 400/- General, OBC, EWS, Other Candidates
  • SC, ST, PWD, ESM, Female : Full Refund After CBT Exam

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
